name: Slack
description: Send alerts to a Slack channel (using webhooks).

USE_SLACK.help: Enable sending alerts to a Slack channel.
USE_SLACK.label: Use Slack

SLACK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.help: Retry to send the request if Slack API is rate limiting us (may consume a lot of resources).
SLACK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.label: Retry if limited by Slack

SLACK_ALERT_IPS.help: Only notify denied requests from these IPs/networks (separated with spaces). Leave empty to notify every denied request.
SLACK_ALERT_IPS.label: Alert IPs

SLACK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.help: When SLACK_ALERT_IPS is set, send one summary notification if this many requests from other IPs are denied within SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD (0 to disable).
SLACK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.label: Unlisted IPs threshold

SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.help: Period in seconds used to count denied requests from IPs not in SLACK_ALERT_IPS.
SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.label: Unlisted IPs period
